import sys


def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    r = int(data[0])
    c = int(data[1])
    nums = [int(x) for x in data[2:2 + r * c]]

    cells = []
    for p in range(r * c):
        i = p // c
        j = p % c
        d = i + j
        inner = i if d % 2 == 1 else -i
        cells.append((d, inner, nums[p]))

    cells.sort(key=lambda t: (t[0], t[1]))
    print(" ".join(str(t[2]) for t in cells))


main()

import random
import sys


def main():
    seed = int(sys.stdin.read().split()[0])
    rnd = random.Random(seed)
    r = rnd.randint(1, 6)
    c = rnd.randint(1, 6)
    lines = [f"{r} {c}"]
    for _ in range(r):
        lines.append(" ".join(str(rnd.randint(-99, 99)) for _ in range(c)))
    sys.stdout.write("\n".join(lines) + "\n")


main()
